services.name: Railway Concession
services.eligibility: Bonafide students below 25 years of age.
services.description: Provides season ticket concession between the student's nearest residence station and Kopar station. Long journey concession is granted during vacation as per railway rules (office info up to 3:00 PM).
documents_required: Student's Full Name, Address, Class, Roll Number, Date of Birth
Attested photocopy of Ration Card or valid residential proof
Submission time: Between recess & after lectures on working days in office

services.name: Bonafide Certificate
services.description: Official college certificate certifying student enrollment status.
documents_required: For Regular Students: Application with Student's Full Name, Address, Class, Roll Number, Date of Birth, Academic Year (e.g. 2024-25)
For Repeater Students: Application + Attested photocopy of last year's mark sheet

services.name: Fees Receipt
services.description: Official receipt of college tuition and administrative fee payments.

services.name: No Objection Certificate (N.O.C.)
services.description: Issued for admission transfer or external examinations upon obtaining clearances.
documents_required: Application with Full Name, Address, Class, Roll Number, Date of Birth, Programme studied
Attested photocopy of last year's mark sheet
'No Dues' remark from Library, Laboratory, and Accounts section

services.name: Transfer Certificate (T.C.)
